questions.title: Q1
questions.text:
In a House of Quality (HoQ), what is the main purpose of the matrix?
A) To translate customer requirements into technical requirements
B) To calculate product cost only
C) To schedule production activities
D) To select suppliers only

options.A: To translate customer requirements into technical requirements

questions.question_stem: In a House of Quality (HoQ), what is the main purpose of the matrix?

questions.title: Q4
questions.text:
In HoQ terminology, what are the customer requirements commonly called?
A) HOWs
B) WHATs
C) ROIs
D) KPIs
questions.question_stem: In HoQ terminology, what are the customer requirements commonly called?

questions.title: Q6
questions.text:
What is the primary purpose of the roof of the House of Quality?
A) To list customer complaints
B) To show correlations among technical requirements
C) To calculate employee performance
D) To display product advertisements

options.B: To show correlations among technical requirements

questions.question_stem: What is the primary purpose of the roof of the House of Quality?

questions.title: Q13
questions.text:
What is the main benefit of using an HoQ during product development?
A) It connects customer needs with engineering decisions
B) It eliminates all product testing
C) It replaces every engineering drawing
D) It guarantees zero production defects

options.A: It connects customer needs with engineering decisions

questions.question_stem: What is the main benefit of using an HoQ during product development?

questions.title: Q3
questions.text:
What do the technical requirements in an HoQ represent?
A) Customer complaints only
B) Measurable engineering characteristics that address customer needs
C) Marketing slogans
D) Production employee details

options.B: Measurable engineering characteristics that address customer needs

questions.question_stem: What do the technical requirements in an HoQ represent?

D) Attractive appearance

questions.title: Q8
questions.text:
If a customer requirement has a high importance rating and a strong relationship with a technical requirement, what does this indicate?
A) The technical requirement deserves greater attention
B) The requirement should be removed
C) The customer requirement is irrelevant
D) The product should be discontinued

options.A: The technical requirement deserves greater attention

questions.question_stem: If a customer requirement has a high importance rating and a strong relationship with a technical requirement, what does this indicate?

questions.text:

D) Target Value Table
questions.question_stem: Which part of the HoQ shows the relationship between customer requirements and technical requirements?

questions.title: Q12
questions.text:
If two technical requirements have a negative correlation in the HoQ roof, what does it mean?
A) Improving one may adversely affect the other
B) Both requirements are identical
C) Neither requirement is important
D) Both requirements must always increase together

options.A: Improving one may adversely affect the other
options.D: Both requirements must always increase together

questions.question_stem: If two technical requirements have a negative correlation in the HoQ roof, what does it mean?
